summary.text: John Burkel is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 1A, with a tenure beginning in 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Burkel's career experience includes serving as chairman of the board of directors of Northern Pride, Inc.

paragraphs.text: John Burkel graduated from Greenbush High School.

His career experience includes serving as chairman of the board of directors of Northern Pride, Inc., and he has been a member of the Minnesota Turkey Growers Association and the National Turkey Federation.
Burkel succeeded Dan Fabian in District 1A and took office on January 5, 2021.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Agriculture Finance and Policy, Environment and Natural Resources Finance and Policy (as co-vice chair) and Legacy Finance committees.
